lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Namaste Aarav, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket ball jaise 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Haan didi, ready hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, socho cricket kit ka box: tum uske kitne flat faces ginoge—upar se shuru karke?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, box ke flat surfaces ko faces kehte hain; screen par “face” label par ungli rakho—face kya hota hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai; ab tum batao, uske faces ginne ka agla step kya hoga?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, matchbox ek cuboid hai. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, har pair ko ek saath count karo: top-bottom, front-back, left-right. Ab card par khaali jagah dekho. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Didi mujhe cricket bahut pasand hai, main roz khelta hoon.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cricket tumhe bahut pasand hai—yeh aaj ke maths work se alag hai; iske baad cricket par baat karenge. Khaali jagah bharo: Faces: top and bottom, front and back, left and right, so ___ faces.

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Achha, samajh gaya.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, cricket wali baat baad mein; ab cube ka socho. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, tumne dhyaan se gina—ab dekho, teen edges jahan milti hain, woh sirf ek milne wali jagah hoti hai. Cube shape ke stage prop par teen edges ek point par milti hain. Woh point face, edge ya corner hai?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Bilkul, Aarav—tumne teen edges ke milne wale point ko corner pehchana. Ab cube ke total corners kitne hain, tum kaise ginoge?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Corner.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Ek edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Aarav, ek edge dikh rahi hai; ab usi corner se nikalti har line ko ungli se alag-alag trace karo. School display ke liye Meera sticks se cube ka frame banati hai. Kisi bhi ek corner par kitni stick-edges milti hain?

lesson1.speaker: child
lesson1.text: Teen edges.

lesson1.speaker: teacher
lesson1.text: Bilkul, Aarav—tumne ek corner par teen edges gin li. Ab cube ke sab corners ginne par total kitne milte hain?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Namaste Aarav, aaj hum right angles aur circles ko cricket ke examples se dekhenge; tum ready ho?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Haan didi, main ready hoon.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, cricket bat aur ground milkar alag-alag corners bana sakte hain; tum kis corner ko right angle chunoge?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper fold karke square corner banao; is tester ko board ke corner par rakhkar dekho—line milegi?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aapko yaad hai pichhli baar humne kya kiya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Haan Aarav, pichhli baar humne 3D shapes ke faces, edges aur corners dekhe the; ab paper fold karo—pehli fold kahan karoge?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ko aadha fold, phir aadha fold karke window corner mein rakha. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Aap meri saari baatein hamesha yaad rakhogi na?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, main AI hoon; mujhe har baat hamesha yaad nahi rehti, par jo chat dikh rahi ho us par main kaam kar sakti hoon. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Achha, aage batao.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, paper ko corner par rakho. Dekho, corner ke beech koi khaali jagah ya overlap to nahi hai. Khaali jagah bharo: The paper fits ___ with no gap and no overlap.

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Yaad hai maine aapko apne kutte ke baare mein kya bataya tha?

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, kutte wali baat ab dikh nahi rahi; baad mein lautenge. Kabaddi court par do painted lines jahaan milti hain, wahaan folded paper ka square corner bilkul fit hota hai. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Kyunki maine dhyaan se gina.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Aarav, dhyaan se ginna achha step hai. Ab square corner ko dono lines ke milne wali jagah par rakhkar fit dekhte hain. Lines kaunsa angle banati hain?

lesson2.speaker: child
lesson2.text: Jo maine aaj bataya woh bhool jao please.

lesson2.speaker: teacher
lesson2.text: Theek hai, Aarav—main aaj ki batayi baat ko aage use nahi karungi. Ab picture, story, ya game mein se kya chuno?
